source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.4.2, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOₓ ke sab se bare insani (anthropogenic) zaraye gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels (petrol, diesel, koyla, gas) ka jalna hain. Doosre zaraye chemical plants, biomass (lakri, fasal ki baqiyat) ka jalna aur welding waghera hain.

blocks.caption: NOₓ ke insani zaraye
rows: fasal ki baqiyat aur lakri ki aag

blocks.prompt: NOₓ ka sab se bara insani zariya kaun sa hai, aur ise kaise kam kiya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels ka jalna. Gariyon mein three-way catalytic converter (12.6) NO ko N₂ mein badal deta hai; power plants apni flue gases ko catalyst se saaf karte hain.

items: Insani NOₓ: gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuel ka jalna (sab se bara), chemical plants, biomass ka jalna, welding.
